evidence.detail: Implementation of forecasted_positive_net_edge relies on static calibration thresholds (forecast_probability >= 0.65) that require live out-of-sample data.

proposals.expected_effect: Will gather empirical evidence on probability calibration, actual net edge vs forecasted edge, and cross-chain cost variance.

proposals.shadow_test: Execute strategy in SHADOW mode for at least 100 eligible opportunities. Monitor probability calibration (Brier score) and simulated net P&L. Stop if simulated net edge consistently falls below 0 after costs.

proposals.expected_effect: Assess if liquidity confirmations genuinely reduce execution failure rates compared to raw price momentum on Solana.

summary: Completed architecture-only review of strategy laboratory and execution rules due to missing fresh runtime forensics. The architecture correctly separates economic signals from chain-specific execution, maintaining shadow safety. No claims of profitability, canary-readiness, or live-readiness can be made. Proposing continued SHADOW testing of predictive and momentum strategies to gather required cost and execution evidence.
